title: Solomon's Death and Rehoboam's Succession
description: After forty years of reign over all Israel in Jerusalem, Solomon rested with his fathers and was buried in the city of David. His son Rehoboam became king after him. The rest of Solomon's acts are recorded in the chronicle of Nathan the prophet, in the prophecy of Ahijah the Shilonite, and in the visions of Iddo the seer concerning Jeroboam son of Nebat.
